worktree.label: Worktree diff
worktree.uncommittedFilters: Uncommitted changes aren't included: this repository uses git filters, which beekeeper doesn't run.
worktree.uncommittedMismatch: Uncommitted changes aren't included: that folder isn't this agent's worktree of the repository.
worktree.uncommittedNoWorktree: Uncommitted changes aren't included: this agent's worktree folder isn't available.
worktree.archived: Diffs aren't available for archived sessions.
worktree.gitNotFound: Git isn't installed, so the diff isn't available.
worktree.gitTooOld: This version of git is too old to show the diff. Update git to see it.

failure.tooLarge: The diff is too large to show.
failure.timeout: Git took too long to produce the diff.
failure.tooMany: This session has too many worktree agents to diff them all.
failure.noBase: There's no base branch to compare with.
